text_segments.text: Completed rig up and prespud inspections, drilled and installed mousehole, spudded PV13 drilled to 23.5mMD and ran conductor #1.
FORECAST OP'S Waited on Haliburton cementers to reset hours, cement conductor, wait on cement, install riser, make up BHA and Drill 17 1/2" hole.
1. PTSM; Daily work scope, BBS cards, PTW, JSA and prespud check lists.
2. PTSM; Discussed making up BHA, housekeeping, grader working on road and prespud documents.
Gel Spud Mud 1 Move/ Rig Up/Down
6:00 [ 1 ] Mixed spud mud and LCM pill, surface lines pressure tested to 250/2500 psi - OK, made up BHA and prepared to drill mousehole.
9:00 [ 1 ] Drilled mouse hole and installed mouse hole sock.
10:00 [ 1 ] Broke down and laid out 12 1/4" BHA.
11:00 [ 1 ] Reset rig smart and crown-o-matic set points.
12:30 [ 1 ] Held PJSM, discussed handling BHA, Driving to the conditions with Grader on road.
14:30 [ 1 ] Made up 24" BHA, Centralize BHA in sub-base for hole centre.
15:30 [ 1 ] Conducted Muster drill and 1 man missing drill, Conducted Pre-spud hazard hunt, Held pre-spud safety meeting with all personnel.
17:30 [ 2 ] Spudded PV13 and drilled 24" hole from 8m to 23.5m RT
19:45 [ 5 ] PJSM, pumped out and cleaned out cuttings from cellar.
20:15 [ 6 ] PJSM, racked back BHA and stood in mast.
23:00 [ 12.1 ] PJSM, picked up and ran 20" conductor casing, made up and ran cement stringer.
0:00 [ 12.2 ] NPT- Waited on Haliburton cementers to reset hours.
3:00 Waited on Haliburton cementers to reset hours.
4:30 Rigged up to cement, PJSM, mixed and pumped 3.5 bbls 15.8 ppg cement plug through stinger inside casing.
6:00 Waited on cement. Laid out stinger.
POB-36: Ensign - 20, CT - 4, OICS - 3, Halliburton - 4, Pason - 1, OCS - 1, SiteMed - 1, RMN - 1, ERMS - 1
RECEIVED: Drill water and mist pumps.
RIG MGR: Gary Hender / Adam delaine
